'''Nena's ship'''<ref name="Concept Art gallery">{{SW|url=the-engineer-concept-art-gallery|text=The Engineer Concept Art Gallery}} {{C|Slides 10, 11 and 12}}</ref> was a [[Starship|ship]] owned by the [[Nikto]] [[engineer]] [[Nenavakasa Nalor]].<ref name="The Engineer" /> In [[34 ABY]],<ref name="Date">{{ResistanceDate|2|5}}</ref> Nalor feigned damage to her ship in order to board the [[supertanker fuel depot]] ''[[Colossus]]'' in order to [[Sabotage of the Colossus|sabotage]] it for the [[First Order]].<ref name="The Engineer" />
